She wears a cream-colored t-shirt with a yellow illustration and patterned shorts. She holds a red pouch with a cartoon face. (2) The girl moves into a hallway and living area. The home has light wooden floors and white walls. She is wearing a red string around her neck. She looks into different rooms curiously. (3) The camera focuses on the girl's face in close-up as she counts and reacts to her surroundings. There are bits of food on her chin. The lighting is bright and even across the indoor space. (4) The girl is shown hiding in corners and behind door frames, laughing and peeking out. An adult's arm occasionally enters the frame to guide or interact with her. (5) The girl sits on the floor hugging an adult female who has a cat emoji mask over her face. They are surrounded by children's toys and furniture. (6) The video ends with a solid pink background featuring a small cartoon illustration of the girl and the text 'POPO'S DAILY LIFE'.

The BGM remains in a positive major key. (5) Fast-paced laughter and overlapping dialogue between the adult and child. Occasional sounds of playful scuffling and door movement.
